title: RuntimeLockFile
description: Contents of ~/.thaddeus/runtime.lock written by the runtime on startup. File mode must be 0600.

token.description: Base64url-encoded 256-bit bearer token. Rotated on every runtime start.

version.description: Runtime semantic version. Used by the shell during the IPC hello handshake.

ipcEndpoint.description: OS-specific transport address. Named pipe name on Windows, UDS path on macOS/Linux.

sidecarPids.description: PIDs of long-lived child processes the runtime owns (e.g. whisper, piper). Used to kill stale sidecars on next start.
